segments.text: What if the best thing that ever happens to you... has not happened yet?
Allah has prepared for His righteous servants a reward no eye has ever seen, no ear has ever heard, and no heart could ever imagine.
Gardens beneath which rivers flow. Whenever they are given fruit from it, they will say, this is what we were given before. And they will abide there, forever.
There, you will have whatever your soul desires, and whatever delights the eyes. And you will remain, forever.
So do not give up. What is waiting for you is worth every single day of the wait.
